title: How to Buy Affordable Tickets to Olivia Dean’s The Art of Loving Live Tour Online
summary: The tour will be the Grammy-winning artist's first world tour.
contentText:

Grammy winning best new artist Olivia Dean is setting off on her first-ever world tour. Titled The Art of Loving Live, the 54-date tour will kick off in North America on July 10 in San Francisco and then hit major cites like Los Angeles, New York and Atlanta before wrapping up Aug. 29 in Austin, Texas. The “Man I Need” singer will also have stops across Europe later this summer.

Get Olivia Dean Tour Tickets on StubHub

Since the release of her second album, The Art of Loving , Dean has skyrocketed across the airwaves with hit singles like “Lady Lady,” “So Easy” and “A Couple Minutes.” The 26-year-old UK artist boasts four songs on this week’s  Billboard Hot 100 , including “Man I Need” that peaked at No. 2 as well as sitting at No. 8 on the current  Billboard 200 , which peaked at No 3.

After opening up for  Sabrina Carpenter  on the final leg of the Short n’ Sweet Tour last year, Dean’s upcoming The Art of Loving Live is are already selling out many tour dates. Even after the issue with TicketMaster raising ticket prices , which Dean had some harsh words for and ultimately influenced the site to later cap all future resale ticket prices and refund fans for the tour on its platform, fans are eager to see the singer live.

If you are searching for tickets to see Olivia Dean, we’ve compiled a guide to buying affordable tickets to her tour through reliable resell ticketing sites like StubHub , SeatGeek and VivdSeats . Here’s how to buy your Olivia Dean 2026 concert tickets before they’re gone.
